## ⚠️ If anyone is in danger right now
- 112 — National emergency number (police, fire, ambulance)
- 181 — Women Helpline

# Complaint regarding criminal intimidation and harassment by ex-husband - Request for FIR

**To:** The Station House Officer, ExpressWay Police Station Police Station (submit at the police station or on your state police portal)

Maine aapke liye ExpressWay Police Station ke SHO ko ek complaint draft ki hai. Isme aapke ex-husband dwara di ja rahi dhamkiyon aur unke ghar ke bahar aane ki ghatna ka zikr hai. Maine isme saaf likha hai ki aapke paas call recordings aur messages ka saboot hai aur pehle police station jaane par koi sunwai nahi hui. Aap ise print karke station mein submit karein aur wahan se receipt zaroor lein.

```
To,
The Station House Officer
ExpressWay Police Station Police Station


Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Complaint regarding criminal intimidation and harassment by ex-husband - Request for FIR

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally report the ongoing harassment and criminal intimidation by my ex-husband. He has been consistently calling me to threaten that he will come to my house and physically harm me. Last night, he was physically present outside my residence, which has caused me severe mental distress and fear for my safety. I have documented these threats through call recordings and messages, which I am ready to provide as evidence. I had previously approached the ExpressWay Police Station regarding this matter, but my complaint was not heard or registered. I request you to kindly register an FIR against him immediately based on these facts. Please provide me with a free copy of the FIR as per the law and initiate a thorough investigation to ensure my protection. If this complaint is not addressed, I will be compelled to escalate this matter to the Superintendent of Police/Deputy Commissioner of Police as per the legal provisions.

Yours faithfully,
Shikha
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

Keep a copy and ask for a signed, stamped receipt (or the FIR copy) when you submit this.
```

## Where to report, and if the police don't act
1. **Station House Officer (SHO), ExpressWay Police Station** (written complaint at the police station · e-FIR on your state police citizen portal where available) — Give your written complaint at the police station. For a cognizable offence the police must register an FIR; you can report at any police station (zero FIR) and you are entitled to a free copy. Get a signed and stamped receipt for your written complaint. · 112
2. **Superintendent of Police / Deputy Commissioner of Police** (complaint in writing by registered post or in person) — If the SHO refuses to register an FIR: send the substance of your complaint in writing to the SP/DCP (BNSS, 2023, s.173(4)). Keep the postal receipt.
3. **Judicial Magistrate** (application through a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority (free if eligible)) — If the police still do not act: apply to the Magistrate to direct registration and investigation (BNSS, 2023, s.175(3)). https://nalsa.gov.in · 15100

_Information, not legal advice._
